description: 130 m² photo studio project by DUMSKAYA DESIGN featuring interior design, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. Reception, makeup area, cyclorama and themed photo zones. Commercial interior design services in Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Photo Studio Interior Design & Custom Furniture, 130 m²

blocks.text: Photo Studio Interior Design & Custom Furniture, 130 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed and completed the interior design project for a 130 m² photo studio, including turnkey renovation with design supervision and custom furniture design.

The photo studio was planned to accommodate different professional shooting scenarios while providing a comfortable working environment for the team. The project includes a corridor, reception area, dressing room, makeup area, themed Barbie room, a space with a cyclorama and a loft area with several photo zones.

Particular attention was given to functional zoning, lighting, the organization of shooting areas and the creation of diverse interior settings within a single studio. This approach makes efficient use of the available space while providing different visual environments for photo and video shoots.

The project also included custom-designed furniture, such as a reception desk with wall panels, makeup tables, wardrobes, cabinets, shelves, a bed and other interior elements. Designing the furniture together with the interior made it possible to maintain a consistent concept and use the available space efficiently.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides photo studio and commercial interior design, custom furniture and turnkey renovation services in Bratislava and Vienna. We develop comprehensive solutions for photo studios, beauty salons, offices, shops, showrooms and other commercial spaces — from the initial concept and technical documentation to custom furniture production and complete interior implementation.
